column1: # One case per row, tab separated: area, then as JSON the arguments, stdin and files (written to the directory it
# runs in), then jq 1.8.2's exit status, stdout and stderr, which `python cli/jq_cases.py` in tools/tests writes. Seven fields hold
# stury to jq's answer. Ten add stury's own exit status, stdout and stderr, for where docs/cli.md says stury differs,
# and a row only stury answers has null null null for jq's three. The arguments may be
# {"env": {NAME: VALUE}, "args": [...]} or {"stdout": "closed", "args": [...]}, and an area starting with ! marks a
# A text cell may be {"cat": [text or [unit, count], ...]}, the parts joined with each unit repeated count times.
